entries.author: eallam
entries.current_title: Show HN: We built a developer-first open-source Zapier alternative
entries.excerpt: For the past few months we’ve been building Trigger.dev and can now share our beta with you: https://github.com/triggerdotdev/trigger.dev . Trigger.dev is an open source platform that makes it easy for developers to create event-driven background tasks directly in their code. entries.guide_zh: Trigger.dev 让开发者在代码中编写事件驱动后台任务，提供开源自动化方案。

entries.title: Show HN: Turn Your Pandas Dataframe into a Tableau-Style UI for Visual Analysis
entries.author: AwsmDef
entries.current_title: Show HN: Turn your Pandas dataframe into a Tableau-style UI for visual analysis
entries.excerpt: Hey, guys. I've just made a plugin which turns your pandas dataframe into a tableau-style component. It allows you to explore the dataframe with easy drag-and-drop UI. You can use PyGWalker in Jupyter, Google Colab, or even Kaggle Notebook to easily explore your data and generate interactive visualizations. PyGWalker (pronounced like "Pig Walker", just for fun) is named as an abbreviation of "Python binding of Graphic Walker". Here are some links to check it out: The Github R
entries.guide_zh: PyGWalker 把 Pandas 数据框变成 Tableau 风格界面，通过拖拽探索数据。

entries.title: Show HN: Filmbox, physically accurate film emulation, now on Linux and Windows
entries.author: wilg
entries.current_title: Show HN: Filmbox, physically accurate film emulation, now on Linux and Windows
entries.excerpt: We released Filmbox two years ago, and it has gotten a great response. It's been used in huge movies like "Everything Everywhere All At Once". It's been a huge rewrite to get this working on Linux and Windows from our original Mac and Metal code. We also have some interesting uses of cross-platform Swift + Electron in our plugin manager app, and cross-platform Swift generally in the plugin. Hopefully we can detail that in a blog post at some point. There's a free Filmbox Lite
entries.guide_zh: Filmbox 将物理胶片模拟扩展到 Linux 与 Windows。

entries.title: Show HN: We’re open-sourcing our session replay tool
entries.author: podoman
entries.current_title: Show HN: We’re open-sourcing our session replay tool
entries.excerpt: Hey HN! We’re open-sourcing highlight.io ( https://github.com/highlight/highlight ), a session replay and error monitoring tool. Highlight.io gives you a high-precision video-like replay of what users are doing when an error or exception occurs in your web app, along with a full-fledged error monitoring experience (similar to bugsnag, rollbar, etc..). entries.guide_zh: Highlight.io 开源会话回放与错误监控，帮助看到网页出错前的用户操作。

entries.title: Show HN: Glidesort, a new stable sort in Rust up to ~4x faster for random data
entries.author: orlp
entries.current_title: Show HN: Glidesort, a new stable sort in Rust up to ~4x faster for random data
entries.excerpt: Hi all, I've talked about glidesort a few times on HN already, but it's finally ready for release. If you have any questions, feel free to ask. An academic paper on glidesort that goes into a lot more detail than the readme is upcoming, but is not ready yet. I will be giving a talk on glidesort tomorrow at FOSDEM 2023 in the Rust Devroom at 16:10, you can seek me out there as well.
entries.guide_zh: Glidesort 用 Rust 实现稳定排序，作者报告随机数据上最高约四倍加速。
